The Eightfold Covenant, Book One

The Mercy of Ruin

He walked away from the law to escape his past. Then the past came looking for him.

When raiders burn Zion's Vale, former Sentinel Jovan Ga'al emerges from the flames with a mysterious medallion—and a forbidden power he once spent years policing.

“I write about dangerous frontiers, buried truths, and broken people discovering they are still capable of extraordinary things.”

About

Michael Eidson

A U.S. Navy veteran, former combat journalist, criminal investigator, endurance athlete, and outdoorsman—now a novelist. His stories draw from classic Westerns, military history, and mythology.

He has always been drawn to the places where character is tested. The Mercy of Ruin is his first novel.
